description: React component for displaying and managing subscription pricing plans, including plan selection, plan updates, billing portal access, and plan change confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: PricingDialog
methods.description: React functional component for subscription pricing dialog, handling plan selection, updates, and billing portal access.

methods.name: handlePlanClick
methods.description: Handles plan selection, redirects for 'Enterprise' plan, and fetches customer default source.

methods.name: handleBillingPortalClick
methods.description: Opens billing portal in a new window.

methods.name: handleUpdatePlan
methods.description: Updates the subscription plan, dispatches success, and handles errors.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the main dialog if not updating.

methods.name: handlePlanDialogClose
methods.description: Closes the plan confirmation dialog if not updating.
